savedSearch.name: Web journey stalls after confirmed deposit
savedSearch.where: ServiceName = 'loyal-frontend' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] IN ('production','prod') AND LogAttributes['loyal.traffic.kind'] = 'external' AND LogAttributes['loyal.flow.name'] = 'earn.deposit' AND LogAttributes['loyal.flow.outcome'] = 'timed_out' AND LogAttributes['loyal.flow.stage'] = 'position_visible' AND LogAttributes['loyal.chain.state'] = 'confirmed'

alert.name: Confirmed web deposit not visible after 60 seconds
alert.message: Owner: web Earn. Flow: earn.deposit; step: position_visible. A confirmed, recorded deposit remained without an authoritative visible position for 60 seconds in an active browser. Do not deposit again: inspect RPC read freshness and position reconciliation. The alert group identifies the client release; the matched rows identify affected journeys and users. Evidence: https://observability.5.161.121.229.sslip.io/search/6ace1464f1ee537a8e910b64 ; dashboard: https://admin.askloyal.com/journeys

telemetryOutage.activateAfter: At least one deployed production telemetry_heartbeat is observed; absence before deployment is not an incident.

alert.name: Web telemetry missing for 15 minutes
alert.message: Owner: web platform. Synthetic telemetry heartbeat missing for 15 minutes (expected every 5 minutes), independent of user volume. Journey rates may be incomplete; do not interpret silence as zero failures. Inspect the deployed web release, Vercel cron invocation /api/cron/telemetry-heartbeat (200 accepted, 503 exporter failure), and collector health. Evidence: https://observability.5.161.121.229.sslip.io/search ; dashboard: https://admin.askloyal.com/journeys

releaseRegression.window: rolling 6h; 7d older-release baseline; excludes journeys younger than 10m
releaseRegression.verification: Live tile returns 0 before rollout; read-only SQL fixtures: regression=1, nine-journey low volume=0, already-unhealthy baseline=0. Notification delivery/recovery not verified.
